import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    private static int dim, limit;
    private static int[][] capacity;
    private static List<List<Integer>> adjList;
    private static int[] level;
    private static int[] iter;

    private static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        adjList.get(u).add(v);
        adjList.get(v).add(u);
        capacity[u][v] = cap;
    }

    private static boolean bfs(int src, int dst) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[src] = 0;
        q.offer(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v : adjList.get(u)) {
                if (level[v] == -1 && capacity[u][v] > 0) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[dst] != -1;
    }

    private static int dfs(int u, int dst, int flow) {
        if (u == dst) return flow;
        for (int i = iter[u]; i < adjList.get(u).size(); i++) {
            iter[u] = i;
            int v = adjList.get(u).get(i);
            if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && capacity[u][v] > 0) {
                int f = dfs(v, dst, Math.min(flow, capacity[u][v]));
                if (f > 0) {
                    capacity[u][v] -= f;
                    capacity[v][u] += f;
                    return f;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static int dinicFlow(int src, int dst) {
        int result = 0;
        while (bfs(src, dst)) {
            Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs(src, dst, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                result += f;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        dim = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        limit = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int total = 2 * dim * dim + 2;
        capacity = new int[total][total];
        adjList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            adjList.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        level = new int[total];
        iter = new int[total];

        String[] sci = new String[dim];
        String[] capStr = new String[dim];
        int[][][] vert = new int[dim][dim][2];
        int badPos = -1;

        int nodeCnt = 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            sci[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                char c = sci[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    int nd = nodeCnt++;
                    addEdge(0, nd, c - '0');
                    vert[i][j][0] = nd;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    badPos = 100 * i + j;
                    sci[i] = sci[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + sci[i].substring(j + 1);
                }
            }
        }

        int maxNode = nodeCnt;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            capStr[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                char c = capStr[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    int nd = maxNode++;
                    addEdge(nd, 1, c - '0');
                    vert[i][j][1] = nd;
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] distFromBad = new int[dim][dim];
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distFromBad[i], limit + 1);
        }
        if (badPos != -1) {
            distFromBad[badPos / 100][badPos % 100] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(badPos);
            int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
            int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int pos = q.poll();
                int x = pos / 100, y = pos % 100;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                    if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim &&
                        sci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && distFromBad[nx][ny] > distFromBad[x][y] + 1) {
                        distFromBad[nx][ny] = distFromBad[x][y] + 1;
                        q.offer(100 * nx + ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};

        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                if (sci[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && sci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    int[][] reach = new int[dim][dim];
                    for (int x = 0; x < dim; x++) {
                        Arrays.fill(reach[x], limit + 1);
                    }
                    reach[i][j] = 0;

                    if (capStr[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && capStr[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                        int u = vert[i][j][0], v = vert[i][j][1];
                        addEdge(u, v, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                        addEdge(v, u, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    }

                    Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
                    q.offer(100 * i + j);
                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        int pos = q.poll();
                        int x = pos / 100, y = pos % 100;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                            int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim &&
                                sci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && reach[nx][ny] > reach[x][y] + 1) {
                                if (capStr[nx].charAt(ny) >= '1' && capStr[nx].charAt(ny) <= '9') {
                                    if (reach[x][y] + 1 <= distFromBad[nx][ny]) {
                                        addEdge(vert[i][j][0], vert[nx][ny][1], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                                        addEdge(vert[nx][ny][1], vert[i][j][0], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                                    }
                                }
                                if (reach[x][y] + 1 < distFromBad[nx][ny]) {
                                    reach[nx][ny] = reach[x][y] + 1;
                                    q.offer(100 * nx + ny);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinicFlow(0, 1));
    }
}
